headline: IAM policy grants S3 access to all buckets in the account instead of a specific data bucket

findings.evidence_ref: The Resource field in the policy changed from `["arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data", "arn:aws:s3:::acme-prod-data/*"]` to `["*"]` in plan.txt. The policy grants s3:GetObject, s3:PutObject, and s3:ListBucket actions.
findings.explanation: The application role now has GetObject, PutObject, and ListBucket permissions on every S3 bucket in the account, not just the data bucket. This includes the marketing site bucket and any new buckets created by other teams. To solve the paging problem, use a data source or a properly scoped policy that allows analytics to add bucket ARNs to a separate variable instead of granting blanket access to all buckets.
